mapper.update: UPDATE pe_pipeline_execution SET status = #{toStatus}, row_version = row_version + 1, updater = 'SYSTEM', update_time = NOW(3), started_at = CASE WHEN #{toStatus} = 'RUNNING' AND started_at IS NULL THEN NOW(3) ELSE started_at END, finished_at = CASE WHEN #{toStatus} IN ('SUCCESS','FAILED','CANCELLED','COMPENSATED') THEN NOW(3) ELSE finished_at END WHERE execution_id = #{executionId} AND status = #{fromStatus} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: select * from pe_pipeline_execution where execution_id = #{executionId} and deleted = 0 limit 1
